/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/BOEING_2017_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
for i,el in enumerate(data.get('texts',[])[:200]):
    t=el.get('text','')
    if any(k in t.lower() for k in ['telephone','phone','registrant','principal executive offices','boeing company','chicago']):
        print(i, el.get('page_no'), repr(t[:500]))
PY"
